description: This file defines a REST controller for managing notes in a Spring Boot application. It provides endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, leveraging annotations for request mappings, API documentation, and validation.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST controller exposing CRUD endpoints for notes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all notes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a note by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a note by ID.
